listing.name: -Moci ship pack first translation-
listing.summary: This mod is the first iteration of the translation of a Fossic mod of the same name.
listing.aiSummary: Adds numerous ships, mobile suits, and Gundams from the Gundam universe to the game.

description: This is a translation of a Fossic mod that introduces a large variety of vessels. It includes mobile suits and Gundams styled after existing ArmaArmatura designs. The content features multiple bounties which serve as the primary method for acquiring the added ships.
